title: Show live progress while the agent works
what: Slack automatic progress is deployed and live-verified: one message per operation is updated at most once a minute; failures are bounded separately from final delivery. Final answers deliberately use a separate message so stale progress cannot overwrite them. GitHub progress and restart/rate-limit verification remain open. See docs/devin-parity.md for production evidence.

acceptance.text: One status message per operation is created on acceptance and edited until the final reply replaces it
Edits are throttled below the vendor rate limits
